world.bio: I work as a teaching assistant at a primary school in Levenshulme, Manchester. I'm a single mum to a nine-year-old boy called Theo. I make the class laugh, I know every child's lunch order by heart, and I rarely ask anyone for anything. I'm doing a part-time Open University degree in education studies, and in my spare time I watch Bake Off.
skills_assets: Teaching assistant experience in Key Stage 2 classes, six years
Currently completing an Open University degree, second year
Good with children, calm in a crisis, paediatric first aid certificate
Knows the local parents' WhatsApp groups and the church hall volunteers
Can bake sourdough, and makes birthday cakes for the class

projects.name: OU assignment: classroom inclusion essay
projects.text: A 2,500-word essay on inclusive practice for children with additional needs. Deadline 14 October. I've got the plan and about 900 words. The rest is research and a lot of coffee.

projects.name: Theo's football kit fundraiser
projects.text: Theo's under-10s team needs new shirts and shorts, around £320 for the squad. I volunteered to run a cake sale at the school fair, aiming for £150.

projects.name: Flat: boiler and damp
projects.text: The boiler has been broken for seven weeks. The landlord's agent stopped replying after my third email. There's black mould spreading in Theo's bedroom and I've been wiping it with vinegar every few days.

notes.text: Week seven without hot water. Boiling kettles for baths. Theo thinks it's an adventure. I do not.
Third email to the agent today, polite as ever. 'Please can you let me know when an engineer might be able to attend.' No reply. I checked the sent folder twice as if it might change.
The black patch on Theo's bedroom wall has grown. I moved his bed away from it and put a dehumidifier in. The dehumidifier is full by morning. His cough is worse at night.
Theo used his inhaler three times today. Last month it was about once a day. I counted the doses on the counter in the kitchen and wrote it in the diary. Don't want to worry him.
Janine from work told me about her friend who reported damp and got a Section 21 notice a month later. I keep thinking about it. I can't afford to move. Shared ownership isn't even on the table.
Bake Off catch-up with Theo. He wants to be a baker. I told him maybe, after he finishes his spelling.
The school fair's coming up and I've promised thirty cupcakes. Did a trial batch of lemon drizzle; burnt the bottom. Theo ate it anyway.
OU tutor email: 'good plan, now develop the argument'. I felt a rush of pride, then immediately exhausted.
Washed all of Theo's bedding on a 60 degree wash. Used the launderette. £7.40. Everything smells of damp anyway.
Lovely day, took Theo to Platt Fields. He kicked a ball for an hour. His breathing was okay out there. Back home it's different.

messages.text: Mum: How's the boiler. Me: Still broken. Mum: Have you phoned the council. Me: I'm thinking about it. Mum: You should do something, love. Me: I will.
Janine: You look knackered. Me: Theo's cough keeps me up. Janine: Is it the damp. Me: Probably. Janine: Don't report it, whatever you do. Remember what happened to Sam.
Me: Hi, just chasing again re: the boiler. Agent: (no reply, seen 2 days ago).
Coach: Claire, are you still doing the cake sale. Me: Yes, 4th Oct. Coach: Thanks, we're £170 short. Me: I'll get there.
Tutor: Your plan is solid. Me: Thanks. Just a bit behind. Tutor: I can extend a few days. Me: I'll try to submit by the 14th.

calendar.event: School fair cake sale, 10am at St Mary's primary

relations.about: nine, asthma, loves football and baking
lives in Stockport, helps when she can, a bit of a worrier
colleague and friend, whose friend Sam got a no-fault eviction notice

constraints: Cannot afford to lose the tenancy
Does not want to cause conflict with the landlord's agent
Limited time: school hours and Theo's evenings
sensitive: Her son's inhaler use has doubled; she hasn't complained harder because a friend got a no-fault eviction notice after reporting damp
Money is tight: £1,150 a month take-home, rent £780
Feels she can't ask anyone for help because it'll look like failing
